title: UTM Parameter Template
description: Standard schema and default configuration for UTM tracking parameters in QR codes.

utm_source.description: Identifies which site, platform, or physical collateral sent the traffic (e.g. flyer, banner, magazine, packaging, standee).

utm_medium.description: Identifies what type of link was used (e.g. qr, print, cpc, display, offline).

utm_campaign.description: Identifies a specific product promotion or strategic campaign (e.g. spring_launch, webinar_q1, event_2026).

utm_content.description: Identifies specific creative variations, physical placements, or sizes (e.g. table_tent_a, roll_up_entrance, a5_flyer).

utm_term.description: Identifies search terms or audience targeting keywords.
